svg.text: STUDY 011 — THE SHRINKING STREET
one-point perspective: one VP on your eye level, figures shrinking by the honest 1/z — construction left in
horizon — your eye level, always
heads ride one rail to the VP
feet ride another — same height, same eye level
VP
I. THE STREET — every receding edge aims at the one VP
the same walker at 3.5 / 7 / 12 / 20 m — shrunk by 1/z, never by copying
II. THE DIAGONAL METHOD
equal depths without a ruler
half the depth, for free
the X finds the tile's center — diagonals stay diagonals
a horizontal through it is the half-depth line; repeat in the far half for quarters
III. THE LIES — three ways to break it
LIE 1 — copy-paste figures: same size at every depth. depth dies.
LIE 2 — one street, three vanishing points. pick one.
rails meet here — but the horizon is down there
LIE 3 — rails must meet ON the horizon: it is your eye level.
what it taught: one vanishing point on your eye level rules every receding edge — equal steps shrink by the honest 1/z, never by copying
leave the construction in — the X, the rails, the VP. students are told to, and it reads as confidence
